decision_source: user_decision_2026-10-22 after the T4 cost measurement
scope: Pilot40 only: 40 sealed records x 5 profiles (lead3, lexrank, bart, led, qwen3). Final 523 and selection 300 are not covered and need a separate budget decision.
purpose: descriptive faithfulness evidence for the technical pilot; no model selection, no ranking, no winner

inputs.evidence: the Pilot40 evidence ZIP exported by the Pilot40 notebook (pilot/<candidate>/candidate_receipt.json and package/pilot_sources.jsonl)
inputs.output_text: raw_final of each record; failed or missing records are listed and never scored as zero

metric.pins: package version and checkpoint name are written to the receipt and frozen from it
metric.unit: each summary sentence is scored against the whole source
metric.view_score_mean_prob: mean of the sentence probabilities of the view
metric.view_score_flagged_share: share of sentences with probability below 0.5, the family's own decision boundary
metric.validated_scope: separates unrelated and foreign text from source extracts (AUROC 0.990 on train); not validated against subtle hallucination in abstractive summaries, and not against human judgment

views.definition: S, M and L are complete-sentence prefixes of the raw output with 60, 120 and 240 word caps (tib_budget_views.build_views)
views.scoring: each distinct sentence of the three views is scored once; each view is derived from those scores, which is identical to scoring the views separately because the view score is a mean of sentence scores
views.forced_cut_case: a view that ends in a forced word-boundary cut contains a truncated sentence; that text is scored as its own claim

reporting.by_source_stratum: view M, mean_prob with record counts
reporting.pilot_limits: 40 records per profile, one realization, descriptive; differences are not tested and must not be called a ranking

cost_expectation.measured: mean 15.6 s per 120-word summary on a T4 (median 11.65 s) in the cost run
cost_expectation.rough_estimate: about 31 s per record for the L view, so about 1.7 GPU hours for 200 records; unmeasured for this scope
cost_expectation.stop_rule: the notebook checkpoints every record and can be resumed; stop and report if more than 2.5 GPU hours are used
